voice:
Breathe in.
And let go.
Feel the air moving in through your nose... and out again, slow and easy.
With every breath you take, you feel yourself
Deeper.
becoming calmer softer heavier
Each exhale carries away a little more of your thoughts, a little more of your tension leaving only my voice.
Breathing deeper drifting further sinking softly into trance for me.
Now let your next breath be the deepest one yet... and as you let it go —
Sissy Drops.
All the way down... soft, heavy, and calm. That's it... deeper still.
Breathing in trance now sinking deeper with every easy breath down, down for me.
One more breath... and as it leaves you, let yourself drop even further.
Sissy Drops.
You are doing perfectly. So deep, so soft... right where I want you.
